title: Pure Magistus
summary: Magistus cards with generic staples. The page's combo replays add Fairy Tail, Endymion and Witchcrafter cards, and its Tier 1 build adds Dracotail, so they use cards this list leaves out. Spenta, the newest Main Deck card, discards itself to search any Magistus monster and later equips a Magistus from the Extra Deck or GY. Crowley, the Gifted Magistus Fusion Summons on arrival and counts as Aleister the Invoker for Invoked Magistus Omega, the newest Fusion. The Magistus monsters equip each other from the Extra Deck, and Zoroa, the Magistus Conflagrant Calamity shuts off opposing monsters that share a card type with your equipped Magistus.
